scope: R98 data/model sidecar only; no GPU, SGD, protocol lock, or results
status: implementation, official checkpoint and full18 all81000 TRAIN targets ready

api.predict_features: predict_features(query_features, query_source_ids) -> float64[N,K] raw GAP means; reduced R97 input feature width
api.predict: predict(query_features, query_source_ids) -> raw mean argmin local candidate IDs
api.factory: code.V4.r98_model.public_regressor(config, device); config keys library_root and regressor_parameters
api.runtime_metadata: runtime/runtime_metadata.json and runtime/provenance.json (identical config-ready receipts, written after verified checkpoint download)

decisions.value: Use native TRAIN raw_label.pkl only, never held-out labels or FP32 caches
Target output root contains PROBLEM/G.npy and PROBLEM/identity.json; preserve existing directories and reject mismatched identity
Queries use already-transformed reduced-width R97 features, never feature plus supervision dictionaries
Sequential lazy scalar fit(kv_cache=False) then predict(output_type=mean); release each regressor before constructing the next
Native public regressor internally applies float32 and affine target scaling; sidecar computes, stores and supplies raw FP64 relative gaps without nonlinear transforms
